**SurgeXXL 0.1.2** — Surge XT 1.3.4's synth engine as a native MPC OS instrument for the Force (MPC OS 3.x).

Every Surge factory and third-party patch (3008) and wavetable (761), your own patches (SAVE) and wavetables (`/sdcard/SurgeXXL/Wavetables`), eight pages with Q-Links, every Surge effect except Spring Reverb (Airwindows included). See the README for the pages and folders.

> **LOAD still crashes some Forces (0.1.0, 0.1.1).** This version writes a crash log, `/sdcard/SurgeXXL/surgexxl.log`: if MPC goes down, the file says where. Also new: the Q-Link order from the SurgeXXL Q-Link Map, and hardening around LOAD (8 MB load-thread stack, no exception leaves the plugin). Installing over 0.1.x replaces it.

## Requirements

- A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM: Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X, Key 61), **MPC OS 3.x** (the skin uses 3.x features).
- **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device, i.e. a modded unit. Installing plugins this way is unofficial: back up first, use at your own risk.
- About 450 MB free on `/sdcard` (the patches and wavetables).

## Install (scripted)

1. Unzip, then copy the whole folder to the device: `scp -r SurgeXXL-0.1.2 root@<device-ip>:/tmp/`
2. Run it: `ssh root@<device-ip> sh /tmp/SurgeXXL-0.1.2/install.sh`

The installer stops MPC (save your project first), copies the plugin folder into `/sdcard/Synths`, backs up `MPC.settings`, adds SurgeXXL to MPC's plugin list and starts MPC again. Running a newer version's installer upgrades in place. Your own patches and wavetables live in `/sdcard/SurgeXXL`, outside the plugin folder, and are never touched by install, upgrade or uninstall.

Then add **SurgeXXL** to a track from the plugin browser (Instrument plugins). Manual install steps are in the zip's `INSTALL.md`.

## Uninstall

`ssh root@<device-ip> sh /tmp/SurgeXXL-0.1.2/uninstall.sh`
